title: Zeros and Their Distribution for Leonardo Polynomials
summary: We investigate the zeros of Leonardo polynomials and their distribution in the complex plane. We show that the structure of the zeros differs between even and odd degrees. For even degrees, all zeros are simple and purely imaginary, with imaginary parts lying in \((-2,2)\). For odd degrees, there is exactly one positive real zero, whereas no negative real or purely imaginary zeros occur. We obtain two-sided bounds for the unique positive real zero, prove that it decreases strictly to zero as the degree increases through odd values, and determine its asymptotic behavior.
